name: Encited
description:
Encited connects Claude to your Encited account so it can research, diagnose and fix search and AI-visibility issues on your sites without leaving the chat.

What you can do with it:

- Technical SEO audits: start a crawl of a domain, then review per-page health scores, status codes, load times, head fields and content metrics, plus an aggregated issue summary with severities and sample pages.
- Seach Console MCP: see which pages sit in Discovered or Crawled, currently not indexed, inspect individual URLs in Google Search Console, and find the indexed inbound links most worth refreshing to trigger a recrawl.
- Crawl log analysis: query recent search and AI crawler visits by provider, path, status and outcome, and get aggregate stats on pages crawled, crawls served and crawl-budget savings.
- Search Console analytics: site health, top queries, and per-page clicks, impressions, CTR and average position.
- AI visibility tracking: monitored prompts and their runs, brand mention position and sentiment, the domains AI providers cite, the fan-out queries they run behind their answers, and a side-by-side comparison against competitors.
- Content workflows: browse Encited's research and content-production pipelines, start a run, and pull the finished document, with credit balance and per-run cost visible before you spend.
- Pre-rendering: inspect cached prerendered snapshots for a page, including SEO analysis and the rendered HTML served to crawlers.

Authentication is via OAuth against your Encited account, and every tool operates on the domains in that account. Read-only tools dominate the toolset; only the audit and workflow tools write or consume credits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Encited to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Encited to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://encited.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Encited MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Encited lists 57 MCP tools, including add_ai_prompt, add_domain, check_keyword_coverage, create_brand_book, create_report, delete_domain, delete_keyword_search, delete_report, generate_brand_book, get_ai_prompt_run, get_brand_book, and get_crawl_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Encited?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Encited in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Encited requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Encited is developed by Encited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
